frequency_source: CorCenCC lemma frequencies (Yr Amliadur); not wordfreq
note: Tiers are equal-count splits on CorCenCC Zipf rank (1 = most frequent). Assignment is by rank, not hard Zipf thresholds (boundary ties). Lexical synthetic future is out of grid; target coverage is infin + pres/past/imperf × 6. Pool excludes auxiliaries, a QA blocklist, and raw < 2.
